other_conditions: Child must belong to a labor family native to Madhya Pradesh.
Child must be of a registered laborer in the unorganized sector.
Student must have passed the 10th or 12th board exam conducted by the Madhya Pradesh Board of Secondary Education in a government school.
Student must be among the top 5000 merit list in the state.
Applicant must be studying in a government school of Madhya Pradesh.
Parent (construction worker) must be aged between 18 and 60 years.
benefits_summary: One-time scholarship of Rs. 25,000 per student.
